Dear Sir:

We are having forwarded to you from the Durham Branch, 100 pounds of SWEET CAROLAL Cut Tobacco. It is our understanding that you will make two samples of this,- treating one lot with menthol, plus rum and the other with menthol and LUCKY STRIKE flavor.

Mr. Gibson will also turn over to you, 200 pounds of LUCKY STRIKE Tobacco. The first 100 pounds of this tobacco he has completely manufactured with finishing flavor and in the second 100 pounds he has eliminated the finishing flavor. In the case of your tests, in the lot with the finishing flavor you will add your menthol and rug, and of lot No. 9 (which does not have the finishing flavor) you will make two samples -

1- Menthol and LUCKY STRIKES FLAVOR

5- Menthol and rua

Please see that these samples are kept separately and are easily identified by the factory. In fact, it would be a good idea to have, say ten cortons of each sample made.
You should use all precaution to see that the tobacco are evenly sprayed with your solution.

[SIGNATURE] Very truly yours.
Cathy

J. Crowe

ASSISTANT TO VICE-PRESIDENT
